prompt:
Find what the Debian project officially states about the support period of a stable release, including LTS. Cite the Debian page and quote the relevant statement.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the official Debian website, here is the information regarding the support period for a stable release, including Long Term Support (LTS).

The standard support period for a Debian stable release is approximately 5 years: 3 years of standard security support followed by approximately 2 years of Long Term Support (LTS). The LTS support is provided by a separate team of volunteers.

The official sources and quotes are as follows:

SOURCE: https://www.debian.org/security/ | QUOTE: "Each Debian release receives security updates for approximately 3 years after the initial release on the architectures which are supported by the Debian security team." | CLAIM: The standard security support period is approximately 3 years.
SOURCE: https://www.debian.org/security/ | QUOTE: "Additionally, several years of extra support ( Long Term Support - LTS ) are provided by the Debian LTS team." | CLAIM: LTS provides extra years of support beyond the standard 3-year period.
SOURCE: https://wiki.debian.org/LTS | QUOTE: "The Debian Long Term Support (LTS) project is designed to extend the lifetime of all Debian stable releases to (at least) 5 years." | CLAIM: The total lifetime of a release, including LTS, is extended to at least 5 years.
SOURCE: https://wiki.debian.org/LTS | QUOTE: "The Debian security team provides security support for a Debian release for about three years after it is published." | CLAIM: Reiterates that the standard security support is about 3 years.
SOURCE: https://wiki.debian.org/LTS | QUOTE: "The Debian LTS team will provide security support for i386, amd64, armel, armhf and arm64 architectures." | CLAIM: LTS support is provided for a specific subset of architectures, not all that were originally released.
